description:
StudentHouse.com are delighted to present this high-quality student accommodation at 409 Stillorgan Road.

Now available for summer bookings, with strong demand for the 2026/27 academic year.

All bills included (free Wi-Fi up to 100mb). Fully furnished single bedroom with en-suite, situated within a shared apartment.

This residence is ideally located within a 25-minute walk to UCD, with excellent transport links to Dublin City Centre via the E1 and E2 bus routes along the N11 Central Bus Corridor.

This property offers a quieter, more private living environment with a limited number of rooms, making it ideal for focused study while remaining well connected to the city.

Please note: Academic year and full-year bookings are currently fully reserved, and a waiting list is now in operation. A waiting list is now in operation. Availability may arise, and similar options may be available.

Viewing highly recommended.
